findings.detail: Explicit drive_a/drive_b absent from the capped limit=1000 list become first/distinct fallback IDs, then URL replacement canonicalizes those new IDs. Absence from a bounded list does not establish nonexistent drive identity. Mechanism can silently change an explicitly requested pair.
findings.fix: Default only absent selections; retain requested IDs until resolved and explain unavailable/out-of-window selection before deliberate replacement. Do not expand authorization or fetch arbitrary real identities.

findings.detail: Bare formatDateShort/formatDateTime/formatTime calls omit locale/timezone options, so browser locale/timezone bypass saved preferences. Existing useDateFormat binds settings locale/tz_display_default at lines73-88; dateFormat defaults are lines30-81.
findings.fix: Adopt existing useDateFormat for all four call sites and memo dependencies; preserve raw timestamps and independent drive selection.

findings.detail: Battery transition directly interpolates raw start/end percentages instead of preference-bound numeric formatting. This bypasses locale/precision used elsewhere in comparison.
findings.fix: Use existing useNumberFormatting for known endpoints; retain measured zero, unknown em dashes, both endpoints and direction.

findings.detail: Finite measured endBatteryPct greater than startBatteryPct returns null instead of preserving negative start-minus-end battery use. Neutral head-to-head suppresses the physical gain sign; no real gain incident inspected.
findings.fix: Preserve signed measured SOC difference with independent percentage-domain validation; keep totals neutral and missing endpoints unknown.

findings.detail: Progress rounds to 0.01 percentage points; Map keyed by progress overwrites earlier same-side samples sharing rounded/clamped progress. ChartContainer export/dataColumns use these lossy rows while Line consumes per-side series, producing different declared source populations when collisions occur.
findings.fix: Preserve duplicate-progress sample identity in export/text alternative or obtain explicit approved aggregation semantics, not last-write-wins. Preserve null opposite-side gaps/source ordering; no sampling or invented observations.

findings.detail: Identity facts and advantage explanatory captions use truncate without wrapping/title/disclosure/full-text recovery. Source-level long/scaled/localized full-content recovery gap confirmed; actual pixel clipping NOT observed.
findings.fix: Use full wrapping/captions or reachable existing disclosure; preserve distance/duration/battery/conditions and complete explanations on narrow layouts.

findings.detail: deriveDataState exposes initial+isRefreshBlocked on paused first load, but page passes only isLoading. Local state adapter cannot distinguish blocked from fetching, StaleRefreshWarning hides without data, header freshness omits fetchStatus; only skeleton loading remains for this state.
findings.fix: Expose existing neutral paused/deferred initial trust state and source retry/resume without claiming device offline or server failure; keep shells. Confirm existing copy before any separately leased catalog addition.
